body:
Bought some CO2 charges to do a poor man's carbogen.
Cracked it into a ballon ala nitrous.
Since I don't have access to pure O2 and O2 is tricky and dangerous I'm not going for the full on effect. Basically I'm bleeding in a stream of gas on the in breath to raise the CO2 level of normal air.
The effect is immediate. Taste is like breathing in a soda burp only stronger. Heart rate and breathing urge immediately stronger.
Heart rate and breathing urge immediately stronger.
Feel light-headed and flushed. Its kind of a pleasant feeling except for the feeling like I need to breath more.
At the peak I have a transportive vision where I'm walking down a shady lane in the summer time. Seems quite real at the time.
Interesting substance. No big urge to revisit it, but no aversion either.
